designDecisions: Decision: R2-F01 is a material implementer edit, not an operator decision. Only CloseHvRunOutputCommand checks ReviewerConfigurationVersion. FailHvRunCommand first attributes a nonzero exit or launch failure to the reviewer and marks it Offline without checking the version. An old probe of configuration v1 can therefore take v2 Offline after UpdateHvReviewerCommand has made v2 Unverified and requested its probe. The worker_shutdown branch can also write a probe request for an obsolete configuration. Rationale/evidence: Trace: claim probe v1; update to v2; v1 exits nonzero; Fail sets the reviewer Offline. The successful-exit stale guard at 1046 does not execute. This contradicts UC-HV-02 and FR-MCP-HVPIPE-003-AC007, which promise a stale probe leaves the newer configuration unchanged. Alternative rejected: approving this contract while the stated trace violates its requirement. Required correction: Apply the current-configuration guard before every probe readiness or probe-request mutation, including failure, shutdown and expiry paths. Preserve newer readiness and pending work. Add named stale nonzero/launch/shutdown/expiry cases and propagate their outcomes to diagrams and TEST records.

Decision: R2-F02 is a material implementer edit, not an operator decision. A server-corrupt probe leaves readiness unchanged and forbids a new probe until a caller requests one. When that readiness is Unverified, HvWorkerHost startup nevertheless requests a NONCE for every enabled Unverified reviewer. Restart therefore retries the failed probe without the required caller. Repeated restarts while storage remains corrupt repeat the work and incident path. Rationale/evidence: The initial Unverified probe can fail V-1 with evidence_corrupt; Close leaves it Unverified. The startup rule has no distinction between never probed and explicitly awaiting a retry. This is exactly the automatic re-probe the remediation claims to have prevented. Alternative rejected: approving this contract while the stated trace violates its requirement. Required correction: Persist and honor the distinction between initial qualification and a failed probe awaiting explicit retry, or otherwise make the startup predicate exclude the latter. Specify configuration-change, shutdown and lease-recovery behavior without reopening the corrupt-probe loop. Add a restart regression case to FR/TR/TEST-003.

Decision: R2-F03 is a material implementer edit, not an operator decision. HostileReviewWorkerHost claims a leased attempt and runs an unbounded review, but defines no heartbeat/renew unit or renewal caller. CompleteHostileReviewAttemptCommand neither releases the lease nor marks the attempt terminal or the successful request completed. ExpireHostileReviewLeasesCommand processes every expired attempt without an active-state filter, an accepted-result guard, or an in-transaction expiry recheck. Healthy long reviews can be abandoned; an accepted result can later have its request requeued or failed. A late completion is promised the accepted result but its stale-fence branch returns stale_fence first. The four HostileReview attempt/sweep DTO names and persistent attempt shape are also not fully defined. Rationale/evidence: The complete host diagram is claim, launch/read, complete, claim. FencedLease users list only artifact Claim, Complete and Expire, none Renew. Expire unconditionally changes the request. The stored requirement requires bounded at-least-once execution and at most one accepted terminal result with distinct identities; three command headings alone do not supply those contracts. Alternative rejected: approving this contract while the stated trace violates its requirement. Required correction: Finish the separate-context contract: define attempt storage and DTO fields, renewal and host scheduling, terminal attempt/request writes and lease release, idempotent completion ordering, and a sweep that rechecks active state/expiry and never changes an accepted request. State caller handling for every command result. Add long-running renewal, completion-versus-sweep, duplicate late completion, cancellation and restart tests in H0/H3, without a reviewer deadline or raw artifact retention.

Decision: R2-F04 is a material implementer edit, not an operator decision. The P5 task explicitly replaces HostileReviewWorkerOptions with the amendment reviewer-pool rule. Section 16.7 explicitly forbids applying that pool, round-robin or NONCE to HostileReview and requires its configured agent or pooled default. P5 is wholly assigned to H0 although that phase stops at stubs and the green mock gate; the runtime options change belongs with the artifact worker implementation. Rationale/evidence: The plugin-read task is at hv-r2-store-REMED-HVPIPELINE-001.txt:40. FR-MCP-HOSTILEREVIEW-003 criterion 4 and section 16.7:1581 require configured/default AgentPool behavior. Section 20.4 assigns P5 and its pins to H0, while the named artifact selection test binds in H3. Alternative rejected: approving this contract while the stated trace violates its requirement. Required correction: Split P5 into the foundation text/configuration retirement and the separate artifact-worker correction. Use the stored configured/default AgentPool rule for the latter, assign its production change and named test to H3 after the mock gate, and reconcile both TODOs and sections 20/21.

Decision: R2-F05 is a material implementer edit, not an operator decision. R-31 validates reviewer overallVerdict against responses still Pending at commit, although the reviewer grades an immutable admitted set and emits its verdict before that commit. A legitimate response DISAGREE caused by scores below 0.98 with all claim findings PASS can leave the review after the verdict. If all other verdicts are AGREE, R-31 now requires AGREE, rejects the previously correct DISAGREE as reviewer_output_invalid, and takes the reviewer Offline. Rationale/evidence: Foundation verdict_match permits a score-based DISAGREE with no FAIL/UNKNOWN finding. Trace: admitted response R scores 0.90; reviewer emits overall DISAGREE; R is rejected/superseded; finalization sees R Closed, all remaining verdicts AGREE and no failing findings. V-3/V-8 now accept the admitted set, but V-4 still rejects it through mutable R-31. There is also no specified atomic revalidation of the same predicate when response state changes after V-4 reads. Alternative rejected: approving this contract while the stated trace violates its requirement. Required correction: Bind validation of the emitted overall verdict to immutable review inputs. If an effective commit-time result is also wanted, define it separately and do not label a correct reviewer output invalid because state changed later. Cover a score-only DISAGREE response closing before verification and between verification and commit.

Decision: R2-F06 is a material implementer edit, not an operator decision. Finalization keeps closed-response findings only in the compressed result document, while FR-MCP-HVPIPE-021-AC005 requires every complete FAIL/UNKNOWN response finding to be an HvFinding row and FR-019-AC002 preserves findings after evidence removal. Removing the result payload can therefore remove those findings from the retained result rows. The canonical result disposition list also permits only Graded or Closed, while Mode Off requires NotGraded with agent_context_disabled. Rationale/evidence: Section 13.4:567 gives the two-value disposition list; 1148 and FR-021-AC002 require NotGraded. The word only at 1148 contradicts the unconditional structured finding requirement at 2648 and retained findings at 2632. Alternative rejected: approving this contract while the stated trace violates its requirement. Required correction: Retain every response FAIL/UNKNOWN as a scoped HvFinding even when its grade is not applied, and define all result dispositions including NotGraded and its reason. Propagate the canonical shape to DTOs, activities, sequences, use cases and store tests. Test closed-response removal and Mode Off result round trips.

Decision: R2-F07 is a material implementer edit, not an operator decision. A-05 replaces section 6.5 but does not name the model-grade sequences in foundation 6.7. A-04 only supersedes the create/get/query sequences. Under the explicit precedence rule, the retained model-grade sequences still require codex exec resume, public grade submission, receipt paths, an Open request and grade-driven outer completion. Separately A-05 retains a 403 agent_context_grader_not_allowed guard, whereas the new internal unit maps that failed guard to retryable 409 conflict and lists no 403. Rationale/evidence: The unchanged foundation sequences at 4375, 4391, 4402 and 4452 directly contradict the internal-only transaction contract at amendment 1234 to 1239. The conflicting status/code is visible entirely within the amendment, independently of interpretation of the foundation sequences. Alternative rejected: approving this contract while the stated trace violates its requirement. Required correction: Explicitly replace or retire every affected foundation model-grade sequence and associated retained caller/check references. Choose one grader-mismatch contract, propagate its status/retryability and caller handling, and remove obsolete receipt/Open/public-grade behavior from the set of foundation clauses that still govern.

Decision: R2-F08 is a material implementer edit, not an operator decision. RecordRead is required only for four public read surfaces. RunReviewerProcess reads Request evidence before launch, FinalizeHvRequestCommand reads and decompresses all chunks outside its write transaction, and ReadinessProbeVerdict consumes stored evidence, without recording an evidence-read ledger row. EnsureAvailable on a later mutation is not a record of the earlier read and cannot refuse that read when audit storage is unavailable. Rationale/evidence: The complete RecordRead user list at 371 excludes these internal readers. Finalizer reads at 1146/1172 and the launch brief read at 1469 have no audited-read operation or refusal branch. This leaves the requested every-evidence-read audit and hard-stop invariant false. Alternative rejected: approving this contract while the stated trace violates its requirement. Required correction: Use a canonical audited evidence-read boundary for public and internal readers, recording access before bytes are consumed and refusing it when the ledger cannot be written. Define how launch, probe and finalizer callers handle that refusal. Add internal-read ledger-failure cases, including no launch after an unauditable brief read.

Decision: R2-F09 is a material implementer edit, not an operator decision. FailHvRunCommand can return not_finalizable, stale_fence, retryable conflict or audit_unavailable without changing state. FinalizeHvRequestCommand handles already_completed in prose but otherwise reports verification_failed with Queued/Failed, and its diagram unconditionally takes that exit. RunReviewerProcess then reports only Completed/Queued/Failed, excluding a request still Finalizing after an audit refusal. A changed request on transaction retry loops directly to reading OutputClosed inputs without repeating the terminal-state dispatch. Rationale/evidence: The callee result list at 1086 and caller paths at 1147/1158 are incompatible. Example: verification fails, ledger becomes unavailable, Fail returns 503 and leaves Finalizing, but the prescribed finalizer exit says Queued or Failed. This is a missing next step for a required internal-unit outcome, not a remaining ability to undo completion. Alternative rejected: approving this contract while the stated trace violates its requirement. Required correction: Dispatch every Fail/finalizer result explicitly, preserve unchanged states and audit_unavailable, return already_completed/not_finalizable as appropriate, and restart retries through the request-state check. Make worker/sweep/activity/sequence exits agree. Add refusal and concurrent-finalization outcome tests. The original R1 F21 overwrite is fixed and remains credited separately.

Decision: R2-F10 is a material implementer edit, not an operator decision. GzipCodec defines evidence_corrupt for Compress/RoundTrip and Decompress. The remediation now handles an append failure, but result compression inside CommitFinalResult has no error branch, returned result or stated worker next step. A persistent result round-trip failure can leave Finalizing on repeated sweeps without the incident/retry contract. Public result/evidence/output decompression can likewise fail, while the public error list restricts evidence_corrupt to admission and the query response contracts omit the corrupt-read outcome. Rationale/evidence: The shared component at 352/360/362 is explicitly used by finalization and all payload readers. FR-011-AC003 covers admission and append only. Neither Finalize results at 1149 nor its commit activity provides the shared component failure continuation. Alternative rejected: approving this contract while the stated trace violates its requirement. Required correction: Specify rollback and caller behavior for result-codec failure, including bounded recovery/incident attribution consistent with existing policies. Define and propagate corrupt-read status/code and audited refusal on each payload-reading surface. Add named result-compression and corrupted-read cases without converting a server fault into reviewer blame.

Decision: R2-F11 is a material implementer edit, not an operator decision. The stored TEST records omit, respectively, ProbeFailuresOfflineWithCodeAndIncident, OverallVerdictHolisticBelow098Disagree and CompressionRoundTripFailureNothingSaved. Each keeps only the second named case from the corresponding FR criterion. Thus the claim that all 63 records equal section 19.1 field by field and every mapping is backed by the complete TEST statement is false. The claimed 157 test names also does not equal the 138 actual named-test occurrences (137 distinct names) in the 133 criteria. Rationale/evidence: hv-r2-catalog-comparison.json compares 1239 fields/status/mapping checks from live plugin reads, with exactly six mismatches: each affected AC003.text and its TEST description. All 21 FRs, their 133 criterion ids/texts, all 21 TRs and all 42 mapping edges otherwise match; all are pending. D-09 defers other existing records, not these new HV catalog records. Alternative rejected: approving this contract while the stated trace violates its requirement. Required correction: Update these three TEST criteria and descriptions through the requirements workflow to retain both named cases. Correct the inventory count and make the equality checker derive every case from every parenthetical test group, distinguishing enum/alias tokens from test names. Re-read all 63 records and mapping edges and report the actual comparison.

Decision: R2-F12 is a material implementer edit, not an operator decision. FR-010-AC007 is wholly assigned to H3 although its review-with-no-records rejection is V-8 plus finalization in H7; Close in H3 only transitions a successful-exit Review to Finalizing. FR-012-AC007 is wholly assigned to HvStorageSchema although it asserts every guarded write and admission refusal, whose wiring and admission unit arrive in H2. A 133-of-133 allocation count therefore does not establish the stated production dependency rule. P7 also has no named test or explicit named traceability check assigned to its correction. Rationale/evidence: The independent phase parser confirms 133 criteria bound exactly once, with zero missing/duplicate/undefined ids. These two counterexamples follow the command ownership and phase descriptions, not a demand for live-server tests at H1. The H1 harness distinction and H6-before-H5 ordering are correct. Searches for P7/EventStreamController show a correction task and broad G5 gate, but no named case for that problem. Alternative rejected: approving this contract while the stated trace violates its requirement. Required correction: Move each whole criterion to a phase where its complete production behavior exists, or split the criterion with explicit phase-specific assertions and named tests while preserving all original behavior. Put the no-record Review case in H7 and the migration guard/admission behavior after H2. Name the P7 traceability verification. Synchronize section 19.4 and both TODO projections; retain the correct H1 harness and H6/H5 ordering.

Decision: credit seventeen round 1 repairs and fail six; do not fail F21 again for the repaired terminal overwrite. Its caller error propagation is a distinct new finding. The exact closure list is in the complete result.

Decision: no new operator decision is required; D-03 remains open. Accuracy 94 and completeness 89 are expert judgments about functioning contracts, not an arithmetic test-pass fraction. Reject approval under the unchanged 98/98 bar.
